Not a good experience as a customer. I paid for the Premium Family Annual Budget spreedsheet. It's good but has flaws and needed to fix. They charge you per modification and their prices are ridiculous. I don't mind paying for the work but some of these fixes take less than 5 minutes and I cannot justify to pay an obscene amount when it is literally copy formula and paste. I bought one mod for $20.90. More than the spreadsheet itself.
Other mods range from $45-$80 to move simple formulas around. They told me to do it myself when asking why so expensive. I did, it worked, and took 5 minutes including creating a reset macro that you'll need for the Calendar tab as data entry is carried over and you clear one by one. I recommend the spreedsheet, I don't recommend the service. Get someone else to modify it or just do it yourself.

Literally NONE of the formulas work! The formulas are there, they just don't work and everything has an error message. I bought this to calculate prices for my items, as well as use the different functions to see how I should change my prices for different margins, etc. NONE of the formulas work and they all have error boxes. Not even the drop down lists work, they just show up blank in the price calculator tab (not the recipe tab, although the recipe tab allows you to list the recipes with drop downs, it doesn't actually calculate anything). This is literally just a decorative word file, itv does not actually have any of the benefits of being an excel sheet, as ZERO, absolutely NO formulas work to calculate anything. Waste of money.

Yeah - I have the chore/routine cards, and they are sexist. And not just a little sexist -- very, very sexist. Please review all images before you buy to make sure they align with your principles. 
Examples: the man-shaped characters are mowing the grass and washing their car, and the lady-shaped ones are doing laundry, cleaning the kitchen, washing their hair, etc. There is no place for this kind of gender bias in a routine chart, of all things. This is just ridiculous and disgusting.
Bonus points that they are also low-grade racist! There is a woman wearing a straw hat and pulling weeds in a flooded field under the "weeding" task card. Awful.
